ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the lower left of the figure there is an amine fragment R–NH2, with a lone pair of electrons drawn beside the nitrogen atom; in the upper right there is an oxygen-containing positively charged carbonyl/oxonium fragment, with a double bond drawn between carbon and oxygen, and the carbon and oxygen are each also connected to a hydrogen atom; the figure also has curved arrows starting from the nitrogen lone pair and the C=O region. Count only the actually drawn bonds between non-hydrogen atoms: one R–N single bond, and one C=O double bond. The total is 2.
